nonvacuity: scratch/UniformChecks.lean compiled successfully: uniformMargins is a probability supported on [-1,1] with no atom at zero, and the anchored continuous unit-ball class contains the zero function. The full diverging h has no closed-form finite witness: its nonvacuity is the analytic existence assertion being certified. It can be constructed by the canonical gliding-hump scheme: choose anchored polynomials p_m with norm at most one, degrees below the later J_m, amplification at least 6*m*4^m and T_(J_m)(p_m) at least half the amplification; h=(1/4) sum_(m>=1) 4^(-m) p_m is continuous, anchored, norm at most 1/12, and has T_(J_m)h at least m/4. Thus the universal non-Lipschitz clause has genuine antecedents. No separate explicit infinite-series Lean witness was compiled.

scratch/FiniteChecks.lean compiled the genuine positive-degree witness n=4, J=1, x=(-3/4,-1/4,1/4,3/4), d=(0,0,1,1), k=1/2. Full rank, Condition 1, positive close counts and strictly bounded model predictions/outcomes are checked. Outcomes y=(1/2,1/2,1/2,1/2) and yprime=(51/100,1/2,1/2,1/2) agree on the close elections but have chosen party coefficients 0 and 1/200. A four-equiprobable-atom model with row-zero outcomes (49/100,1/2,1/2,51/100) and the other rows constant 1/2 has expectation 1/2 at every row, so the degree-one regression is correctly specified and both outcome vectors have positive probability. scratch/RefutationCheck.md writes the printed reading and checks its conditions individually.
